citations.quote: you can use the hand to manipulate an object, open an unlocked door or container, stow or retrieve an item from an open container, or pour the contents out of a vial

why: The spell text neither grants nor forbids this use. Whether 'manipulate an object' extends to it — and any check required — must be resolved as a table ruling by the authorized DM, including the calling agent when it is the DM.
